subject: Isolated-network deep-dive: network/egress & air-gap requirements
messages:
From: Kevin Morris <kevin.morris@sentinellabs.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@sentinellabs.com
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: deep-dive on isolated-network & air-gapped options

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team at Sentinel Labs would like to follow up with a technical deep-dive focused specifically on networking, egress controls, and air-gapped deployment constraints. The main asks from our security and infra leads are:

- Clarify what outbound connections (if any) Redwood needs for management/metrics/updates.
- Options for private control plane vs fully air-gapped (on-prem) install.
- Supported KMS/HSM integrations and key rotation approaches.
- Typical maintenance/patching workflow when there is no internet egress.

We'd like a 60–75 minute session with our security and platform teams; can you propose 2–3 times next week? We are on PDT in the Bay Area.

Best,
Kevin
Kevin Morris
Head of Platform Security, Sentinel Labs

Thanks for the clear list of asks; that helps a lot. We can definitely walk through each of those topics. Proposed slots (PDT):

1) Tue 20 Apr, 10:00–11:15am (we'll reserve 75m for Q&A)
2) Tue 20 Apr, 15:00–16:15pm
3) Wed 21 Apr, 09:00–10:15am

Agenda draft attached (redwood_deepdive_agenda_v1.pdf) and a preliminary network diagram (network-diagram_v1.pdf) showing our recommended control-plane connectivity and optional air-gap pattern. Attendees from Redwood: me (solutions engineering, network & security patterns), Dylan (product/infra — will cover runtime behavior and maintenance), Lauren (sales engineer — procurement/SLA/options). Vivek will join for the KMS/HSM and private control plane sections.

If none of those work, tell us a few times that do and we'll adapt. We can also do the session recorded and send a secure recap if some Sentinel folks can't attend.

Thanks,
